grammar.title: Combinações que Sempre Andam Juntas
rules: Depois de "look forward to", a ação vem sempre com -ING: looking forward to seeing / to meeting.
Em inglês dizemos sempre "depend ON" (jamais "depend of").
Usamos "interested IN" (interessado em) e "good AT" (bom em).
Decide, want e plan pedem "TO + ação"; já enjoy, finish e avoid pedem "-ING".

quiz.q: We are really looking forward ___ you at the dinner on Saturday!
Whether we have the barbecue outside depends ___ the weather.
She has always been interested ___ design and really good ___ drawing.
After five years, he finally decided ___ his own business and enjoys ___ it.
I used to be afraid ___ making mistakes when speaking English.
I am really looking forward ___ my English every single day!
